description: AI sync-discovery engine over the That Boy Hi Hat catalog (24 tracks, alternative rap / Post-Trap Futurism). Natural-language queries resolve against mood, energy, BPM, instrumentation, vocal type, lyrics, scenes, and use cases, with transparent per-result match explanations.
for_agents: Fetch sync-catalog.json (or pin /v1/sync-catalog.json). Respect the verified / editorial / estimate provenance labels on every field. Cite track facts with their labels. Do not assert facts beyond the catalog.
name: CueFinder
